name: text-metrics
purpose: Normalize text and report deterministic character, byte, line and word counts in two script steps.
pre_prompt: Supply a short text whose length matters. This function needs no project paths or implementation. The first step normalizes line endings; the second measures the saved normalized text. Do not use word or byte counts as exact model-token counts.
post_prompt: Interpret the counts against the requested brevity or file limit. Describe normalization if it affects the result. Counts are measured; usefulness and what to shorten require model judgment. This skill does not tokenize text or edit the project.
